rule.description: SCA PVE9 Hardening Independent policy events.
PVE9 Hardening: Debian 'non-free-firmware' repositories are not fully enabled.
PVE9 Hardening: CPU microcode (Intel/AMD) for security mitigations is missing.
PVE9 Hardening: Required packages for UEFI Secure Boot are not installed.
PVE9 Hardening: Kernel Lockdown (Integrity Mode) is disabled.
PVE9 Hardening: Proxmox VE subscription is not active or valid.
PVE9 Hardening: Global Two-Factor Authentication (2FA) config file is empty or missing.
PVE9 Hardening: Critical Proxmox VE service 'pvestatd' is not active.
PVE9 Hardening: 'systemd-boot' manager or its cmdline parameters are missing.
PVE9 Hardening: Required boot packages for UEFI, Shim, or Systemd-boot are missing.
PVE9 Hardening: Server did not boot using UEFI mode (Risk of Bootkits/Legacy BIOS).
PVE9 Hardening: 'systemd-boot' is not being utilized as the primary bootloader.
PVE9 Hardening: UEFI Secure Boot (Shim) is disabled in BIOS/Firmware.
PVE9 Hardening: /boot/efi partition is not mounted with secure mask permissions (umask=0077).
PVE9 Hardening: 'proxmox-boot-tool' status reports errors or un-synchronized ESP partitions.
PVE9 Hardening: Proxmox VE API/Web UI is not listening on the default port (8006).
PVE9 Hardening: Kernel IPv4 Forwarding is enabled (Node behaves as an unintended router).
PVE9 Hardening: No API Tokens are defined in user.cfg for external integrations (e.g., PVE-to-PBS).
PVE9 Hardening ALERT: An API Token has been granted full Administrator privileges.
PVE9 Hardening: Legacy/Insecure remote shell services (Telnet/RSH/NIS) are installed.
PVE9 Hardening CRITICAL: Read, Write, or Checksum errors detected in ZFS pools.
PVE9 Hardening: Debian security updates repository (deb-security) is missing.
PVE9 Hardening: Proxmox update repositories (pve-no-subscription or enterprise) are missing.
PVE9 Hardening: Proxmox Backup Server (PBS) storages do not use SSL Fingerprints.
PVE9 Hardening: Proxmox Backup Server (PBS) storages lack encryption keys.
PVE9 Hardening: Proxmox Firewall is disabled at Datacenter (Cluster) level.
PVE9 Hardening: Ptrace scope (kernel.yama.ptrace_scope) is not restricted.
PVE9 Hardening: IPv6 is not explicitly disabled on the system kernel.
PVE9 Hardening: DCCP network kernel module is not disabled.
PVE9 Hardening: SCTP network kernel module is not disabled.
PVE9 Hardening: Obsolete floppy drive kernel module is not disabled.
PVE9 Hardening: No personalized/nominal user accounts are defined (only root@pam exists).
PVE9 Hardening CRITICAL: Multi-Factor Authentication (2FA/TFA) is completely missing in the cluster configuration.
PVE9 Hardening: PVE Web UI session timeout (ticket_lifetime) is not securely parameterized.
PVE9 Hardening: PVE Proxy Web GUI is still utilizing the default self-signed SSL certificate.
